title.zh: 在Ozamis市设立繁育站，名称为Ozamis繁育站，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing a Breeding Station in the City of Ozamis to Be Known as the Ozamis Breeding Station and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a Breeding Station in the City of Ozamis to Be Known as the Ozamis Breeding Station and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

text.en: There shall be established, under the supervision of the Director of Animal Industry, a breeding station in the City of Ozamis, to be known as the Ozamis Breeding Station.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said breeding station during the fiscal year nineteen hundred seventy. Thereafter, such sum as may be needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 4, 1969.
